critical: capture ring position vs golden band and the resulting grade
MISS / wonder fled and gauge reset
camera or model failure with the photo fallback path
current: resonance gauge %, confidence, cooldown seconds, boost/prism state anchored to the object
stardust balance and prices in the shop
memory stage, points sources, and refine controls
contextual: rank/XP, codex count, quest progress chips
next-goal ladder, recall card, achievements, stats
hidden: other collectors' private (unpublished) memories and save data
raw detector output beyond the chosen target

focus_order: content list or grid (tabs, slots, moments, shop items)
navigation.device_switch: Touch and pointer share the same targets (≥44px); switching to keyboard keeps the current screen and selection, native focus rings appear on buttons; the scan overlay canvas is pointer-only while every other action remains a keyboard-reachable button.
navigation.modal_behavior: Detail modals, sheets, tutorial, and chest are overlays inside the screen root; click/tap outside or the explicit button closes the topmost overlay first and returns to the underlying screen without changing game state.
navigation.destructive_behavior: Reset and delete use a native confirm() naming the exact scope; back or cancel never confirms; gift redemption is additive and duplicate codes are rejected with a reason.

layout.safe_area: HUD, bottom controls, tab bar, and toasts pad by env(safe-area-inset-*); decorative canvas layers extend full-bleed.
anchors: HUD chips stay in the safe top region and never cover the object center
object-anchored gauge, tag, and capture ring follow the smoothed bounding box
companion avatar and controls stay in the bottom-right/bottom safe region
layout.text_scaling: System fonts 10–34px; long Korean wonder names wrap to two lines in slots and cards; chips truncate only the non-critical hint chip with ellipsis.
layout.reflow: Title and meta screens scroll instead of shrinking (flex-shrink:0); chapter tabs scroll horizontally; codex uses 4 columns and album 3 columns; the goals ladder is capped at four rows.
layout.scrolling: Each meta screen owns one vertical scroll region below the header; grids scroll inside the screen with bottom padding for the tab bar; modals do not scroll the underlying screen.

localization.externalized: Not yet externalized: Korean strings live inline in screens and data files; the worlds registry is the planned seam for alternate wonder names and guide lines.
localization.expansion: Buttons wrap or reflow; chips use nowrap only for short labels; card lore and notes wrap freely.
localization.bidirectional: Not reviewed; layout uses left/right physical properties and would need logical properties for RTL.
localization.fonts: System UI stack with Korean fallbacks (Pretendard, Apple SD Gothic Neo, Noto Sans KR); emoji glyphs rely on platform emoji fonts.
localization.input_glyphs: Prompts are text plus emoji (탭!, 긁어서 확인); no device-specific glyphs are required.

signals: grade uses text, color, sound, haptic, and the reward line — never color alone
rarity uses star count text in addition to color
cooldown shows seconds as text with a gray bracket
legendary detection uses vignette plus heartbeat sound plus haptic plus Lupe text
toasts persist ~3.5s with text; quest/achievement completion also appears on their screens
accessibility.settings_entry: Profile → settings is reachable from the title gear icon before any gameplay; settings persist in localStorage and apply immediately.
accessibility.motion: Reduce-motion disables shake, glitch, flash, rays, confetti, aura particles, tag bob, suspense, duel rumble and hit shake; state confirmations remain as text, badges, and sound where enabled; scratch becomes tap-to-reveal.
accessibility.media_alternatives: Sound and haptics are optional toggles; capture clips are optional and never required to progress; no decision depends on audio or haptics alone.

data_bindings.element: scan HUD chips and object-anchored gauge
data_bindings.source: localStorage state (v3) and per-frame scan loop
data_bindings.initial_state: Render current rank/codex/dust/quest counts on entry; gauge starts at 0 with no target.
data_bindings.update: Re-render chips after discover/spirit/quest/achievement events; gauge, tag, ring redraw every animation frame from the smoothed target.
data_bindings.stale: If the target label changes, the gauge drops to 15% and re-locks; if lost for 1.5s during capture, capture cancels and the gauge resets to 50%.
data_bindings.error: Model or camera failure shows the fallback panel with photo upload and a return path; detector exceptions clear the target.
data_bindings.permission: Camera and orientation permissions are requested from user gestures; denial routes to photo fallback without blocking the rest of the game.

data_bindings.initial_state: Read all moments on entry; show the empty state with guidance when none exist.
data_bindings.update: Refine, recall, favorite, delete, and duel write back and re-render the screen; stage badges recompute from points.
data_bindings.stale: Object URLs are revoked on screen exit; storage stats recompute on each entry.
data_bindings.error: IndexedDB failures are caught at addMoment so a capture still reveals without a saved memory.
data_bindings.permission: Only this device's data; cloud upload happens only for a logged-in user's own moments.

data_bindings.source: cloud provider (Firestore public collectors) when enabled
data_bindings.initial_state: Cloud disabled → explanation card; logged out → login button; logged in → list sorted by codex count.
data_bindings.update: Login triggers syncAll and profile publish; public toggle updates the profile document.
data_bindings.stale: List is fetched on entry only; a manual sync button re-uploads unsynced moments.
data_bindings.error: Fetch or auth failures fall back to an empty list with a toast; the local game is unaffected.
data_bindings.permission: Firestore rules restrict reads to public profiles and writes to the owner; storage writes are owner-only and size-capped.

matrix.state: photo fallback capture across AUTO, PERFECT, GREAT, GOOD, and MISS
matrix.expected: Grades match ring radius thresholds; MISS resets gauge and refills; rewards, quests, achievements, and milestones update; no console errors.
Scratch clears past 50%; refine + recall raise the stage with rewards; duel runs three rounds to a result and grants stardust.

matrix.state: live camera capture with clip recording and gyro spirits
matrix.device: iOS Safari and Android Chrome real devices
matrix.expected: Ring taps land inside GOOD/PERFECT windows under touch latency; clip saves as mp4/webm with sound; gyro spirits track orientation after permission; reduce-motion keeps all confirmations as text.

acceptance: Every declared screen state has a reachable and escapable path (verified for desktop emulation).
Trusted game state (codex, cooldown, save schema) is unchanged by presentation settings.
Critical signals use more than one channel and stay inside the safe area.
Cloud-disabled mode is a complete game with no dead UI.
verification.evidence: docs/screens/v2-*.png and v3-*.png, docs/game-feel-contract.json, HISTORY.md §5 and §8 QA tables, DevTools console logs (0 errors after fixes).

decisions.decision: Keep AR as screen-space canvas effects anchored by 3-DoF gyro rather than WebXR world tracking.
decisions.basis: No WebXR dependency, works on iOS Safari, static hosting.

decisions.decision: Cloud behind an env-gated adapter; local mode is the complete game.
decisions.basis: User must create Firebase project; app must not degrade without it.

decisions.decision: Scratch reveal only for first discoveries; tap-to-reveal under reduce motion.
decisions.basis: Preserve surprise without slowing duplicates or excluding motion-sensitive players.

decisions.decision: Title scrolls rather than compresses as content grows (event, recall, goals).

route_out.reason: Remaining risks are device APIs (camera recording, gyro permission, share sheet) and cloud keys only the owner can create.
